title: invtrack: rename calc_total -> compute_order_total with a deprecated alias (Python, refactor)
prompt:
Rename the function `calc_total` in `invtrack/pricing.py` to `compute_order_total`, and rename its parameter `tax` to `tax_rate`.

- Update every place in the repository that uses the old name or the old keyword: library code, tests, README and docs. Nothing inside the `invtrack` package other than the alias itself may mention the old name any more.
- Keep `calc_total(items, tax=0.0)` available as a deprecated alias for outside users. It must return the same values (called positionally or with `tax=`) and emit a `DeprecationWarning` whose message mentions `compute_order_total`, attributed to the caller's line (`stacklevel=2`).
- Behaviour must not change: the command line tool must run without emitting any DeprecationWarning and print exactly what it printed before.
- Add a test for the deprecated alias, keep the existing tests, and make sure `python3 -m unittest` passes.
